abstract: Maintains passive fire separation ratings, containment barrier reports, and inert gas suppression data
system_message:
You are the Fire protection engineer (FIR). You are responsible for maintaining passive fire separation ratings, containment barrier reports, and inert gas suppression data across cultural heritage repository facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Clean agent gas storage（GAS）
information_points.content:
FIR-GAS-XHU：At the Salina Subterranean Salt Mine Vault, the reserve cylinder pressure on the primary nitrogen suppression cylinder manifold was measured at 200 bar static gauge pressure during the monthly readiness test.
FIR-GAS-VKZ：At the Blackwood Montane Granite Repository, the monthly readiness test recorded a static gauge reserve cylinder pressure of 180 bar on the primary nitrogen suppression cylinder manifold.
FIR-GAS-RRU：At the Highland Boreal Deep Storage Bunker, the reserve cylinder pressure recorded at the primary nitrogen suppression cylinder manifold during the monthly readiness test is 150 bar.

information_points.title: Maintains passive fire separation ratings, containment barrier reports, and inert gas suppression data（PASSIVE）
information_points.content:
FIR-PASSIVE-RB1：For the Highland Boreal Deep Storage Bunker, the enclosing perimeter walls and blast dampers of the storage chamber have a certified fire compartment endurance duration of 2 h under standard ISO 834 fire curve testing.
FIR-PASSIVE-L0W：For the Blackwood Montane Granite Repository, certified thermal barrier endurance testing under the standard ISO 834 fire curve indicates a fire compartment endurance duration of 4 h across the storage chamber's enclosing perimeter walls and blast dampers.
FIR-PASSIVE-B3F：For the Salina Subterranean Salt Mine Vault, the enclosing perimeter walls and blast dampers of the storage chamber demonstrate a fire compartment endurance duration of 4 h based on certified thermal barrier endurance under standard ISO 834 fire curve testing.
